Governor Newsom Announces Judicial Appointments 2.10.26

February 10, 2026

SACRAMENTO - Governor Gavin Newsom today announced the following judicial appointments:

Patricia Anne O'Brien, of San Francisco, has been appointed to serve as a Judge in the San Francisco County Superior Court. O'Brien has served as an Assistant United States Attorney at the U.S. Attorney's Office since 2016. O'Brien earned a Juris Doctor degree from Georgetown University Law Center, and a Bachelor of Arts degree from Boston College.

David Lee Martinez-Garcia, of Riverside, has been appointed to serve as a Judge in the Riverside County Superior Court. Martinez-Garcia has served as a Supervising Attorney at Inland Counties Legal Services since 2014. Martinez-Garcia earned a Juris Doctor degree from Loyola Law School, and a Bachelor of Arts degree from University of California, Riverside.
